Subject: EU tax validation for split-invoice flows — quick clarifying Qs

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the heads-up on the invoice pause. I dug into the routing on our side and want to confirm two things so Accounting can remap the charge correctly and avoid duplicate collections:

1) Can you share the VAT registration number you used for the Bright Retail Netherlands entity? The payment we received flagged as a non-EU VAT mismatch (we get a code from Avalara during validation).

2) You mentioned the order is split between Bright Retail Ltd (UK) and Bright Retail EU B.V. (NL). For the Redwood invoice we issued (INV-4892) do you want us to:
   - Issue two invoices (one to the UK entity, one to the NL entity) with net/ reverse-charge lines, or
   - Reissue a single invoice that lists split line-items with appropriate VAT handling per line?

If you can attach the VAT cert for the NL entity that helped in prior quarters, that’ll let us validate quickly and avoid putting AP on hold. I’m looping Marissa for the reissue and Ben for the payment reconciliation logic.

Thanks — if you prefer a quick call, I’m free 11:00–12:00 PT today.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: 20261125-Redwood-invoice-4892.pdf]

Hi Sean,

Thanks — appreciate you chasing. We hit the hold because our AP team couldn't match the VAT number to the NL subsidiary in their system. I attached the VAT certificate for Bright Retail EU B.V. — the registration is NL810223456B01.

On your two options: please reissue two invoices, one to Bright Retail Ltd (UK) and one to Bright Retail EU B.V. (NL). Our internal policy prefers entity-level invoices for cross-border cost allocation.

Also note: our payment team will only pay the NL invoice from the EU bank account; the UK invoice will come from our UK ledger (different payment reference). That means your invoice numbers should make that distinction obvious.

Regards,
Elena
Head of Finance, Bright Retail

- Create INV-4892-EU (payable by Bright Retail EU B.V.) with the NL VAT number and reverse-charge line items where applicable

Elena — assuming the attachments look correct, we'll send the two invoices by EOD and copy the HubSpot deal so your AP team can reconcile.

Thanks,
